summary: Tester pass (A3) on branch task/01-for-index-html-page-please-add, unmerged with main. Ran the existing regression suite under tests/01-for-index-html-page-please-add/ (`npx playwright test`, system Chrome): 152/152 passed. It covers the pinned-port and mind-map-attribute and sequence text formats and round-trips, the port geometry, auto ports, drop resolution, end re-attach, free mind-map drag/colour/auto-layout with one-undo-step checks, sequence layout, reorder and label edit, SVG/PNG export and file names, the sketch tools, undo/redo, insert and ✎-on-picture flows, and the one-modal-at-a-time rule. Added phone.spec.js (5 tests, all pass) for gaps the suite left: nav block byte-identity across all pages, a 390×844 touch viewport with no page or console errors, a touch-pointer sketch stroke, a touch drag of a mind-map node writing {x,y}, and the help text mentioning sequence and sketch in both languages. No product bugs found. Limits: I did not run tests/diagram.js, the neighbour suites (codecopy, timeline, mdundo, cause) or /verify, and could not check the merge with main (the implementer reported it was refused). Compound shell commands (pipes, env prefixes) were refused in this session, so the runs used the bare `npx playwright test` form. Two failures in my new spec while writing it were test errors (nav anchor lacked the aria-label attribute; touch-move events dispatched on a node removed by re-render), fixed in the test, not product defects.
